omissions.pilot/project, review/candidate-source,: Reconstruct from source revisions and hashes; omit redundant repository/Git copies
omissions.scratch, prepared/generated instruction: Generated disposable consumers; retain source identities, commands, logs and check results
omissions.tar/gz/zip files: Redundant source archives; retained logs record identities
omissions.unselected instruction bodies: Discovery metadata and original full input hashes retained; only selected folders/profile bodies copied

path_note: Original logs/scripts contain original sandbox paths. Restage source revisions and adjust explicit sandbox locations for reproduction; raw logs are not rewritten.
